title: Feature Engineering
description: Practitioner-grade feature engineering: when scaling matters, how regularization interacts with feature selection, how to choose filter vs wrapper vs embedded selection, and how to interpret feature-importance disagreements between methods.
outcomes: You'll diagnose when scaling matters and when it doesn't, reason about regularization's effect on correlated features, choose between filter/wrapper/embedded feature selection for real time-and-budget constraints, and reconcile feature-importance disagreements between impurity-based and permutation-based methods.
